connect.description: Starts this chat's SimpleX door (a small container of its own) as `name` and gives it the secret its deliveries to this chat's inbox carry (SIMPLEX_DOOR_SECRET, set toward door.fragment.internal).

state.description: The invitation waiting for its owner's SimpleX app: {invitation: {link, short, at}}, or null.

link.description: Asks the door for a one-time SimpleX invitation for its owner's app, which `state` then shows its owner alone.

unlink.description: Ends the door's SimpleX link to its owner's app.

meta.title: SimpleX
meta.description: A chat with your agent that you also reach from your SimpleX app: your messages there come here as yours, and its replies go back, end to end encrypted between your app and the platform's door.
